text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest overnight gains, with BTC up 1.9% and ETH up 1.6%, signaling modest bullish momentum in the majors. The Fear & Greed Index sits at 57 (greed territory) but has dropped 14 points over the past week, suggesting traders are becoming cautiously optimistic rather than exuberant. Bitcoin dominance at 58.5% with $93B in daily volume indicates a relatively healthy market where capital is flowing across multiple assets rather than concentrating entirely in BTC.
